verdict.rationale: ImageMagick documents its own programmatic APIs, with bindings for C, C++, Python, .NET and Node.js. Its docs say developers can integrate it into applications for resizing, color correction, format conversion and complex transformations. Its scripting-first CLI exposes the same operations. However, nothing in the evidence states that the APIs match every interactive or UI capability, and no HTTP/OpenAPI surface exists (all OpenAPI probes returned 404). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API–UI feature parity, per-operation API coverage evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration that every interactive feature is available through the bindings.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
